subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `deferred` as a public cron status and yielded-parent lifecycle APIs through the Plugin SDK?
rationale: The internal bug needs fixing, but the PR also creates persisted, protocol, CLI/UI, hook, and external plugin contracts whose permanence cannot be decided from code correctness alone.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Represent waiting and settlement through the existing canonical task/session lifecycle without adding public cron or Plugin SDK contracts.

options.title: Adopt public contracts
options.body: Retain the new status and APIs with an explicit compatibility policy, upgrade behavior, documentation, and proof.

options.title: Split the proposal
options.body: Land the internal lifecycle repair separately and review the public status and SDK additions in a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep lifecycle internal
recommendation.body: Represent waiting and settlement through the existing canonical task/session lifecycle without adding public cron or Plugin SDK contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing yielded-subagent lifecycle semantics and has the strongest cross-surface history for the cron, Discord, and Plugin SDK contract decision.
